Subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage, bridge letter & procurement timeline for renewal/expansion

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing the procurement checklist for our upcoming expansion and renewal (MedTech Solutions). Legal and procurement have requested: the latest SOC 2 Type II report, confirmation of audit period coverage, and whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter for any gaps between the report date and our renewal/contract effective date. Our expected renewal window is 2027-01-15 to 2027-02-01.

Two quick asks to keep things moving:
- Can you confirm the audit period covered by your most recent Type II (start/end dates) and whether it covers the controls relevant to data segregation and encryption?
- If there's an audit gap, do you provide a standard bridge letter and how long does that take to issue?

Procurement would appreciate the report/bridge before 2026-12-10 to complete the packet for their committee. If anything needs internal approvals on your side, please flag timeline risks.

Thanks — we can jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Asha Verma
Senior Procurement Manager
MedTech Solutions
[Attachment: MTS_NDA_signed.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear asks and the NDA. Looping in Stephanie (Account Lead) and Monica (Compliance SM) to help with evidence and timeline.

Short answers up front:
- Latest Type II: SOC 2 Type II report dated 2024-05-20 covering period 2023-05-01 through 2024-04-30. That report includes control areas for logical access, encryption in transit and at rest, and change management.
- Bridge letter: Yes — we can provide a bridge letter that confirms continued operating effectiveness of controls since the end of the last period. We maintain a standard bridge template but will tailor it for MedTech. Typical turnaround is 3–7 business days once we confirm the exact control set you need covered.

To meet your 2026-12-10 procurement packet deadline we recommend this plan:
1) Confirm the list of specific controls/categories your compliance team requires (e.g., encryption, backups, access reviews). If you send the procurement checklist we can map items to report sections.
2) We’ll issue the bridge letter within 3 business days after we confirm scope and have sign-off from audit/compliance.
3) We’ll attach the redacted Type II and an evidence index to the packet for procurement.

Attachments I'm sharing now (stubs):
- Redwood SOC2 summary (high level) 
- Bridge letter template (docx)

If that timeline is too tight, let us know where the hard deadline sits in your approval flow (committee date / contract signature target). Happy to schedule a 20-min sync today or early next week.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
